parameters.name: AuthVersion
parameters.description:
The edition of Security Center that is authorized to scan the asset. Valid values:

*   **6**: Anti-virus
*   **5**: Advanced
*   **3**: Enterprise
*   **7**: Ultimate
*   **10**: Value-added Plan

parameters.name: AutoBind
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically bind servers to Security Center. Valid values:

*   **0**: no
*   **1**: yes

parameters.name: Bind
parameters.description:
The UUIDs of the servers that you want to bind to Security Center.

>  You must specify at least one of the **Bind** and **UnBind** parameters.

parameters.name: BindAll
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to bind all servers to Security Center. Default value: **false**. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes
*   **false**: no

parameters.name: Criteria
parameters.description:
The search conditions that are used to filter servers. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and is case-sensitive.

>  A search condition can be an instance ID, instance name, virtual private cloud (VPC) ID, region, or public IP address. You can call the [DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~) operation to query the supported search conditions.

parameters.name: IsPreBind
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to specify servers for protection when you purchase Security Center. Valid values:

*   **0**: no
*   **1**: yes

>  If you specify servers, the servers are automatically added to Security Center for protection after the purchase order is complete.

parameters.name: LogicalExp
parameters.description:
The logical relationship that you want to use to evaluate multiple search conditions. Default value: **OR**. Valid values:

*   **OR**
*   **AND**

parameters.name: NtmVersion
parameters.description:
The edition of Security Center that you purchase in the order. Valid values:

*   **level7**: Anti-virus
*   **level3**: Advanced
*   **level2**: Enterprise
*   **level8**: Ultimate
*   **level10**: Value-added Plan

parameters.name: PreBindOrderId
parameters.description: The ID of the order in which Security Center is purchased and servers are specified for protection.

parameters.name: UnBind
parameters.description:
The UUIDs of the servers that you want to unbind from Security Center.

>  You must specify at least one of the **Bind** and **UnBind** parameters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas bind-auth-to-machine --criteria name_:_riskStatus_,_value_:_YES_,_name_:_internetIp_,_value_:_1.2.XX.XX --logical-exp OR --bind-all true --auth-version 6 --auto-bind 1 --is-pre-bind 1 --pre-bind-order-id 233016000482 --ntm-version level2 --bind 44f9ee5a-e39d-46bb-833b-5fc2ff470000 --un-bind 3e3c9d79-2880-465d-9e1b-1bc2af7d0000 --resource-directory-account-id 1667036095600000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas BindAuthToMachine --region cn-hangzhou --BindAll true --NtmVersion level2 --IsPreBind 1 --UnBind.1 '3e3c9d79-2880-465d-9e1b-1bc2af7d0000' --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 1667036095600000 --Bind.1 '44f9ee5a-e39d-46bb-833b-5fc2ff470000' --Criteria 'name_:_riskStatus_,_value_:_YES_,_name_:_internetIp_,_value_:_1.2.XX.XX' --AuthVersion 6 --LogicalExp OR --AutoBind 1 --PreBindOrderId 233016000482
